description:
rss_parser.cr contains three unused private methods that should be removed for clarity:

1. `count_entity_definitions(content)` (lines ~108-110): Wraps `EntityExpansionGuard.count_entity_definitions` but is never called from within RSSParser — the guard is invoked via `EntityExpansionGuard.check`.

2. `extract_rss_favicon(xml)` (lines ~191-197): Always returns `nil` with only a comment explaining the decision. The decision to skip RSS favicons is fine, but the method is misleading — readers expect a real implementation.

3. `extract_atom_categories(children)` (lines ~374-381): Dead code. Atom categories are extracted inline in `parse_atom_entry` via `(child_map["category"]? || [] of XML::Node).compact_map { |cat| cat["term"]?... }` instead.

Action: delete all three methods. Verify specs still pass (`crystal spec`).
title: Remove dead code from rss_parser.cr
